post.text: The mystery of Satoshi Nakamoto, the pseudonymous inventor of Bitcoin, has remained unsolved for 17 years. Not anymore. Read my 18-month investigation to find out who Satoshi really is. https://t.co/fPtaK6YHJC
post.author_description: @nytimes reporter and bestselling author of Bad Blood: Secrets and Lies in a Silicon Valley Startup. Send story tips to john.carreyrou@nytimes.com
